description: This Java interface defines a factory for creating KafkaPublisherActor instances, providing methods to get actor name and properties based on connection settings.

classes.name: KafkaPublisherActorFactory
classes.description: A factory interface for creating Kafka publisher actors, providing methods to obtain actor name and Props for actor creation.

methods.name: getActorName
methods.description: Returns the name that should be used for the actor created by this factory.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates and returns the Props object needed to instantiate the publisher actor, based on connection parameters and dry-run mode.
